summary: Benchmark database storage with `fio` (`yum -y install fio`, about 60 GB free in `/tmp` or a smaller `size`): run a 4K random write test (`--rw=randwrite`) and a random read test (`--rw=randread`) with `--numjobs=3 --size=10G --runtime=60s --ioengine=libaio --direct=1 --iodepth=64`, logging to `/tmp`.
questions: How do I test disk IOPS for the AAP database?
fio command to benchmark AAP PostgreSQL storage
Does my storage meet 3000 IOPS for AAP?

answer_card.title: Benchmark DB storage with fio
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo yum -y install fio
fio --name=write_iops --directory=/tmp --numjobs=3 --size=10G \
  --time_based --runtime=60s --ramp_time=2s --ioengine=libaio --direct=1 \
  --verify=0 --bs=4K --iodepth=64 --rw=randwrite --group_reporting=1 \
  > /tmp/fio_benchmark_write_iops.log
# same with --name=read_iops --rw=randread > /tmp/fio_benchmark_read_iops.log
grep iops /tmp/fio_benchmark_*_iops.log
```
Needs about 60 GB free in `/tmp` (reduce `--size` for less).
